projects.name: The seed library
projects.description: Collect a packet of four seasonal seeds every season. The seed keeper stocks the cabinet beside the market.

projects.name: The rain cistern
projects.description: The oldest irrigation line runs along the northern row. The cistern waters that row at dawn.

projects.name: The preserving hearth
projects.description: Turn three of any one crop into a jar of preserves. Each batch simmers overnight.
